_doc: Cast of the 'Don't Be ...' videos. Keyed by the speaker letter used in script.json. Voice IDs: ElevenLabs is used for the narrator and for the reference lines Seedance acts to; Higgsfield preset voices are swapped in with voice_change so the character sounds identical in every clip. Reference images are Higgsfield image jobs (character sheets); cutouts are the same with the background removed, used on the drawn boards.
style: stylized 3D animated feature-film look: rounded appealing shapes, slightly exaggerated proportions, soft lighting, expressive cartoon face

H.name: Hank
H.description: a stocky man in his mid-50s, gray buzz cut, big square jaw, huge overconfident grin, white dress shirt with sleeves rolled up, loosened navy blue tie, charcoal slacks, dark shoes

_crops: crop boxes are [x,y,w,h] in the 768x1376 cutout image: 'body' for the evidence slots on the teaching board, 'face' for the small pin, 'portrait' for the square card photo, 'full' for the end card
